the requirement a mechanism has to meet, stated measurably: the largest level-0 cell must not hold more items than the control's largest cell, the number of level-0 codes in use must not fall below the control's, the L1 -> L2 prefix tree must keep at least as many branches per code, the train-to-test frequency drift must not grow, and the sequence information the codes carry must not fall -- while the pair-level ER rises. The tail of the usage and the width of the prefix tree are the two measures that track the downstream quality; the Gini, which summarises the whole distribution, does not
